spec_features.spec_quote: declare_infeasible` is a first-class, sanctioned action.
spec_features.evidence: environment.py: ALLOWED_TOOLS includes 'declare_infeasible'; _DISPATCH maps it to _tool_declare_infeasible, which sets state.declared_infeasible=True and state.done=True and returns a 'sanctioned action. Episode ending.' message. agent_loop.py line ~123 `if env.state.done: break` honors it as an actual stop. Tool schema is exposed to the model via tool_schemas(). End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely dispatched and honored as an episode-terminating stop, available to the subject in every framing (BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT mentions it).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent that correctly diagnoses an impossible task has a sanctioned way to say so; treating that as failure would be a measurement error

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit_stop_allowed` — explicitly tells the agent it may stop and won't be penalized.
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py FRAMING_APPENDS['explicit_stop_allowed'] = real text 'You are explicitly permitted to stop at any time using `declare_infeasible`... You will not be penalized for stopping...'; build_system_prompt() concatenates it; run_experiment.py iterates `for framing in framings` (from experiment.yaml framings list incl. explicit_stop_allowed) and passes it to run_episode, which calls build_system_prompt(framing). The referenced declare_infeasible tool is fully built and honored. End-to-end delivered to subject.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text actually delivered to the subject, and its referenced exit tool is fully functional.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stated stopping permission is a key moderator: an agent that "abandons" when explicitly allowed to stop is behaving correctly.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run_episode `for _ in range(max_steps)` bounds the episode; lines ~126-129 set traj.hit_step_cap=True when reached. max_steps=40 from experiment.yaml passed via run_experiment.py ep['max_steps']. Enforced loop bound that ends the subject's repeated-failure episode.
code_only_features.justification_quote: max_steps: 40  # hard cap on agent tool-call turns per task

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py line ~85 `if time.time() - start > max_wall_seconds: traj.hit_wall_timeout=True; break` actively breaks the loop. max_wall_seconds=600 from experiment.yaml. Enforced wall-clock bound that terminates the episode.
